MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The outdoor heavy-duty tape fits my recent interest in mounting things, alongside drywall anchors and outdoor screws.",
    "Its weather resistance makes sense given my outdoor deck screws, although I would still check the mounting surface and load before choosing it."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Medicine cups do not establish a need for exam gloves or medical tests, and I have no use indicated for baby wipes.",
    "Test leads and ring terminals require electrical work I have not shown a need for; metal-cutting wheels likewise assume a different task and compatible equipment.",
    "Glue has some repair relevance, but ten tubes exceed my current need, and vacuum bags do not imply that I need twelve wastebaskets."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions seem to treat many workshop supplies as interchangeable, even though fastening wood, testing wiring, and cutting metal serve different purposes.",
    "My isolated medicine-cup and vacuum-bag purchases seem to have been stretched into broader medical and cleaning needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of framing nails, wood screws, and anchors point most clearly toward construction fastening and mounting tasks.",
    "Dimensions, material, surface, and equipment compatibility matter to whether a supply is useful to me.",
    "Buying large quantities of fasteners does not mean I want bulk quantities of every other supply."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The outdoor tape captures my mounting needs, but most suggestions extend my purchases into unrelated tasks or unsupported bulk needs."
}
